title: 第1364章 青韵归位第1363章 浑元气息
slug: 太古神墟第1974章药园小酌
content_zh:
苏衍玄一语道破隐秘玄机，众人群情振奋。
诸葛俊羽扇轻拢，含笑对落尘道：
“恭喜主公，更该恭喜我等所有人，恭喜天玄亿万万苍生！”
“此次大劫绝境翻盘，天玄浴火涅盘。
既是主公鸿运齐天，道与天地相和。
也是我等上下同心、众志成城，方扛下这场万古大劫。”
话音稍顿，他轻声提醒道：
“尘埃初定，还纵情庆贺之时，尚有三件要事要马上做。”
落尘微笑点头，接话道：
“诸葛兄所言极是。第一件，我与大师兄‘规定域、矩成法’，稳固天玄全新的天地法则，定立新秩序。
第二件，我同如玉一起，唤醒天地的万物生机。
只是不知这第三件，是何事？”
诸葛俊心情不错，羽扇悠然轻摇，缓缓道：
“这第三件，自然是让仙界一角的诸位同仁以及万千族人，重返故土，着手重建天玄。”
说罢，他微微蹙眉：
“按理而言，界灵青韵姑娘应当已涅盘功成，怎的至今未见现身？
有她相助，重建天地，会事半功倍。”
说青韵，青韵就到，一圈涟漪自云端荡开，微光流转，青韵窈窕的身影缓缓浮现。
此刻的她，脱胎换骨，周身天地道韵萦绕，气机与整片天玄天地浑然相融。
青韵凝望着落尘，躬身深深一礼：

“多谢公子多年守护栽培。”
“您为滋养我灵体，特意开辟十万亩灵药田，悉心蕴养天地灵气；
又倾力打造霸天城，镇守我藏身之地。此恩，青韵铭记于心。
您是天玄之主，青韵愿意永世为公子效力。”
“更谢公子成全，让我得以伴随天玄同浴涅盘。
如今我已蜕变成真正圆满的天地界灵，与这片天地再无割裂。
从今往后，我终于有资格、有能力，为公子分忧出力。”
她抬眸凝望满目疮痍却暗藏新生的山河，轻声续道：
“公子，我能清晰感知，整片天玄正发生亘古未有的蜕变，正朝着无上神域稳步攀升。
“公子只管潜心唤醒天地道韵、巩固新界法则、复苏万物生机。
余下梳理地脉、规整天地秩序、辅助山河重建诸事，尽可交付于我。
如今的青韵，便是这片天地的神明，足以胜任一切。”
content_en:
Su Yanxuan revealed the hidden mystery with one word, and everyone was excited.
Zhuge Jun gently folded his feather fan and said to Luochen with a smile:
"Congratulations, my lord, and more importantly, congratulations to all of us, and to all the millions of people in Tianxuan!"
“This great catastrophe has turned the corner, and Tianxuan has reached Nirvana in the fire.
Since the Lord's good fortune is in the sky, Tao is in harmony with heaven and earth.
It is only through our unity and unity that we can withstand this eternal catastrophe. "
After a pause, he reminded softly:
"While the dust has just settled and we are still celebrating, there are three important things that need to be done immediately."
Luochen smiled and nodded, then said:
"What Brother Zhuge said is absolutely true. The first thing is that Senior Brother and I 'define the domain and establish the law' to stabilize Tianxuan's new laws of heaven and earth and establish a new order.
The second thing is that, together with Ruyu, I awaken the vitality of all things in the world.
I just don’t know what this third thing is? "
Zhuge Jun was in a good mood, swaying his feather fan leisurely, and said slowly:
"This third item will naturally allow all my colleagues in this corner of the Immortal Realm and thousands of clan members to return to their homeland and start rebuilding Tianxuan."
After saying that, he frowned slightly:
"Logically speaking, Miss World Spirit Qingyun should have achieved nirvana, why hasn't she appeared yet?
With her help, rebuilding the world will be more effective with less effort. "
Speaking of Qingyun, Qingyun is here, a circle of ripples spreads from the clouds, the faint light flows, and Qingyun's slim figure slowly emerges.
At this moment, she was completely reborn, with the charm of heaven and earth lingering around her, and her Qi blended seamlessly with the entire Xuantian world.
Qingyun stared at Luochen and bowed deeply:
"Thank you, Master, for your many years of care and cultivation."
“In order to nourish my spiritual body, you specially opened 100,000 acres of spiritual medicine fields and carefully cultivated the spiritual energy of heaven and earth;
I also worked hard to build Tyrant City and guard my hiding place. Qingyun will remember this kindness in her heart.
You are the Lord of Tianxuan, Qingyun is willing to serve the Young Master forever. "
"I would like to thank you more, Master, for allowing me to accompany Tianxuan to bathe in Nirvana.
Now I have transformed into a truly perfect world spirit, and I am no longer separated from this world.
From now on, I am finally qualified and able to help the young master relieve his worries. "
She raised her eyes and gazed at the devastated mountains and rivers hiding new life, and continued softly:
"Sir, I can clearly sense that the entire Tianxuan is undergoing an unprecedented transformation and is steadily climbing towards the Supreme God Realm.
"Young master, just concentrate on awakening the rhythm of heaven and earth, consolidating the laws of the new realm, and reviving the vitality of all things.
The rest of sorting out the earth's veins, regulating the order of heaven and earth, and assisting in the reconstruction of mountains and rivers can be left to me.
Today's Qingyun is the god of this world, capable of everything. "
